title: Application for tax exemption for Bronx affordable housing rehab
summary: The City Council would approve a real property tax exemption for four properties in the Bronx owned by Neighborhood Renewal Housing Development Fund Corporation, as requested by the Department of Housing Preservation and Development. The exemption would run for up to seven years from February 4, 2020 and is tied to continued compliance with an affordability regulatory agreement. It affects properties across Community Districts 1, 3 and 6 and Council Districts 8, 15 and 17.
